title: AgentStrap install stamp (.agentstrap/manifest.json)
description: Written by /agentstrap:bootstrap. Its presence flips a re-run into 'stamped' (sanity-check/upgrade) mode. Records exactly what bootstrap created so re-runs are a desired-vs-actual diff, never a clobber.

created.description: Project-relative paths AgentStrap created (so upgrades touch only its own files).

linked.description: Project-relative paths AgentStrap linked to in adopt mode instead of creating.

conformed_to.description: Existing conventions AgentStrap adapted to in adopt mode (rather than imposing template defaults).
